crossRefs.note: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the…

translations.web: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”
translations.bsb: “No,” he told them. “You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
